# HLL and shared-platform acceptance fixtures

Reserved for synthetic fixture packs with explicit game/locale/publication states. Do not turn reference screenshot users, scores, Steam IDs, rosters or server listings into fixture data.

Implementation must cover CS/EN x HLL/Wardogs; unknown/provisional/confirmed/corrected results; no selected row; empty/filter-empty/stale/offline/unavailable server states; long names; manual category/search/translated-detail behavior; draft/privacy withdrawal; game-scoped grants; mixed/shared configured guilds; multi-page reconciliation and retry.

Video fixtures must distinguish zero/one/multiple enabled clips, fresh document vs client navigation, one failed rendition, autoplay rejection, reduced motion and data-saving mode. Inject a deterministic choice for tests/screenshots. Real stream assets and credentials are supplied separately. This directory is a specification, not passing runtime evidence.
